title: EcoCard: New Customer Promo - 0% APR for the First Year
summary: EcoCard new-customer promo: accounts opened from 2024-10-01 through 2025-03-31 get 0% promotional APR on carried balances for the first 12 billing cycles from account opening. After the 12-month promo, remaining/new carried balances accrue interest at 19.99% if the account stays open and in good standing.
faqs: Am I eligible for the EcoCard 0% APR promo, and what account opening dates qualify?
How long does the 0% promotional APR last (in billing cycles) and when does it start?
Does the 0% APR apply to carried balances, and what happens to interest after the promo ends?
What interest rate applies after the 12 billing cycles end?
What do I need to do to keep the promotional rate (account status requirements)?
How can I plan my payoff so my balance doesn’t accrue interest at 19.99% after the promo?
keywords: account open and in good standing
